node.label: severe Canavan disease
node.definition: Severe Canavan disease (CD) is a rapidly progressing neurodegenerative disorder characterized by leukodystrophy with macrocephaly, severe developmental delay and hypotonia.

neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. severe Canavan disease: amino acid / organic acid metabolism (via MONDO:0017686 inborn aminoacylase deficiency). leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 27: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0100605 POLR-related leukodystrophy). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.25. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no shared specific pathway between the causal genes.
